 Inter Milan vs Fiorentina LIVE streaming, TV channel, kick-off time & where to watch Serie A 2026-27
 By Dilpreet Follow Add as Preferred Source Dilpreet has been covering football since 2020 and writing for Khel Now since 2025, covering World Football with a sharp perspective and a genuine passion for the game. Published at : October 25, 2026 at 4:34 PM (GMT+5:30) Modified at : October 25, 2026 at 5:50 PM (GMT+5:30) Only one of the last five matches between these clubs ended in a draw!
 Fiorentina are now visiting the legendary San Siro Stadium for their eighth matchweek fixture of the Serie A 2026-27 campaign. They will lock horns with FC Internazionale Milano in what could be an interesting outing.
 The Cristian Chivu-led side dropped to second on the Italian first-division points table after Lazio’s 2-1 win over Parma. Inter Milan will be looking to once again clinch first place. With a win, they can do that.
 Being at home is going to be one of the advantages for them. The Nerazzurri must not make mistakes out there, or it can prove costly for them.
 It is the start of the season, and Fiorentina are once again sitting in the bottom three on the Serie A points table. In their first seven matches, they have only managed one win. La Viola are on a two-match losing run.
 They will be under pressure for their next one. With a calm and composed performance, they might secure a point against Inter.
